strategy_evidence.entry_explanation: Prior close must be on the non-breakout side of the relevant opening-range boundary and the current close strictly beyond it, with VWAP, RSI and RVOL at least 1.6 confirmation. A wick touch is insufficient.
strategy_evidence.invalidation: Long: opening-range high; short: opening-range low.
strategy_evidence.stop_rule: Long: max(ORB low, decision low - 0.25 * ORB range); short: min(ORB high, decision high + 0.25 * ORB range).
